decisions.reason: Because it was placed on the home page in both 2018 and 2019, management has made a visible strategic commitment to this cloud email service and is likely to justify past investment by continuing it.
Its dedicated page and named customer result give management public evidence to defend the launch, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
This conversion service was less prominently presented, but it is closely related to the firm's communications core and prior development effort encourages management to persist.
As an optimization feature tied to the firm's established fax business, it likely has low incremental carrying cost and strong strategic fit, which favors retention.

Although only lightly promoted and in a security area where one adjacent offer was already removed, management can still frame weak traction as temporary and is likely to give this invested product more time.
